name: Daou Data Corp.
summary: Daou Data Corp. provides IT and online/offline payment infrastructure services in South Korea and internationally. The company offers software distribution, cloud and software subscription services, software license management services, enterprise IT solutions, IT consulting services, and system integration services. It also provides KIWOOM Pay VAN and KIWOOM Pay PG services, including online, offline, mobile, and easy payment services, dynamic currency conversion, tax refund, merchant management, and secure transaction processing services.
